comparison.objective: Start and torque a bracket bolt with a ratchet in confined access; candidate adjusts and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Socket seating and repeated short ratchet strokes versus recessed hex-key use, counterholding, collar rotation and response-guided iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Bracket seated and bolt reaches 0.4–0.6 N·m versus two acceptable ≥0.85 J stops and witness-tested setting retention.
comparison.reason: Generic fastener/tool use is insufficient for overlap. The record explicitly says live scorer integration is not qualified, but its objective and planned success tiers are still clear enough to distinguish.
